title: Coordenador de Logística - Centro de Distribuição - São Roque Distribuidora - Feira de Santana/BA
description:
Resumo

Coordenador de Logística - Centro de Distribuição (C.D.) na São Roque Distribuidora - Feira de Santana/BA. Buscamos profissional qualificado para liderar e otimizar operações logísticas, com foco em eficiência, rentabilidade, qualidade e integração de processos. O(a) profissional será responsável pela gestão estratégica e execução diária das atividades no Centro de Distribuição, assegurando alto desempenho da cadeia de suprimentos e cumprimento dos prazos de entrega.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão Estratégica: Definir metas e KPIs logísticos alinhados aos objetivos da empresa, impulsionando crescimento e eficiência.
  • Planejamento e Otimização: Desenvolver e implementar planos de ação para redução de custos, aumento de produtividade e cumprimento de prazos operacionais.
  • Supervisão de Operações: Supervisionar as atividades de recebimento, armazenagem, separação, expedição e inventário no CD.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Gerenciar o estoque com foco em acuracidade, controle físico e otimização do espaço.
  • Gestão de Equipe: Liderar e desenvolver a equipe do CD, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance.
  • Análise de Dados: Utilizar dados e ferramentas analíticas para apoiar a tomada de decisões e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Integração Interdepartamental: Atuar com compras, vendas, financeiro e atendimento para garantir fluidez na operação logística.
  • Inovação e Tecnologia: Buscar e aplicar tecnologias logísticas (WMS, TMS) que aumentem a eficiência e competitividade.
  • Controle de Custos: Monitorar os custos logísticos, propondo ações de otimização de recursos.
  • Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Negociar com fornecedores e transportadoras, garantindo bom desempenho e cumprimento dos SLAs.
  • Garantia de Qualidade e Segurança: Assegurar que todas as operações sigam padrões de qualidade e normas de segurança.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Antecipar e resolver problemas operacionais com agilidade e foco em soluções práticas.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Ensino superior completo em Logística, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação será um diferencial.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos em cargos de liderança em logística, especialmente em centros de distribuição.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Gestão de estoque, armazenagem, inventário e expedição. Domínio de sistemas WMS e TMS. Gestão de indicadores logísticos e controle de custos.
  • Habilidades: Liderança, comunicação clara, negociação, pensamento estratégico, organização e capacidade analítica. Proatividade e foco em resultados.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Orientação para resultados
  • Capacidade de adaptação
  • Visão estratégica
  • Espírito de equipe
  • Ética profissional
  • Resolução de problemas

Observações

Informamos que, em caso de aprovação na entrevista, o(a) candidato(a) poderá estar sujeito(a) à consulta cadastral em órgãos de proteção ao crédito, como o Serasa, como parte do processo de validação para contratação. Esta é uma prática de compliance adotada pela empresa.

title: PAP Specialist
description:
AdaptHealth Opportunity - Apply Today!

AdaptHealth offers full-service home medical equipment products and services to empower patients to live their best lives - out of the hospital and in their homes. We are actively recruiting in your area. If you are passionate about making a profound impact on the quality of patients\' lives, please click to apply, we would love to hear from you.

PAP Specialist

Role overview - The PAP Specialist has a broad range of responsibilities including accurate and timely data entry, understanding and selecting inventory and services in key databases, communicating with referral sources, and appropriately utilizing technology to notate patient information and communication. Intake Specialist\'s schedules can vary based on the need of the branch. Hours can range anywhere between 8am and 7pm 7 days/week.

Responsible for ensuring customers receive PAP equipment by scheduling an appointment for the customer to come in to pick up equipment and receive proper instruction on how to best use the equipment. Explains customers financial responsibility and ensures payment.

PAP Specialists are responsible for preparing and submitting audit paperwork for Medicare and other insurance claims to ensure continued compliance with healthcare guidelines. The PAP Specialist will accurately respond to claim audits and communicate audit results in such a way to provide education and appropriate process changes that directly impact the daily functions of AdaptHealth.

Responsible for monitoring, communicating, and managing all clients on Positive Airway Pressure devices. Responsible for encouraging client compliance with PAP equipment and program.

Job Duties

  • Develop and maintain working knowledge of current HME products and services offered by the company and all applicable insurance guidelines respecting eligibility for coverage and reimbursement.
  • Actively involved in team activities, evidenced by participation, mentoring, and training with co-workers
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of reference materials for use by staff and facilitates the sharing of information
  • Develop relationships with branches and other teams to accomplish goals
  • Participate in monthly team meetings and trainings
  • Enter data accurately into databases including payer, authorization requirements, coverage limitations and status of any requalification
  • Collaborate with physician offices, AdaptHealth sales and support staff to ensure timely receipt of documentation as well as educating, as necessary
  • Identify trends and provide feedback and education to internal and external customers on compliant documentation requirements for services provided
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and function within the guidelines of HIPAA
  • Complete assigned compliance training and other educational programs as required
  • Maintain compliance with AdaptHealth\'s Compliance Program
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

Minimum Job Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • One (1) year work related experience in health care administrative, financial, or insurance customer services, claims, billing, call center or management regardless of industry
  • Senior level requires two (2) years of work-related experience and one (1) year of exact job experience
  • Exact job experience is considered any of the above tasks in a Medicare certified HME, Diabetic, Pharmacy, or home medical supplies environment that routinely bills insurance

EEO Statement

AdaptHealth is an equal opportunity employer and does not unlawfully discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on the basis of an individual\'s race, color, religion, creed, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. This policy applies to all terms, conditions, and privileges of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, compensation, promotion, discipline, and termination.

Job Description

The E-Commerce Marketing Manager (LATAM Marketplaces) will lead strategy and execution across Mercado Libre and other key Latin American platforms. This role drives growth through marketplace marketing strategies, campaign management, content optimization, and performance analysis, while collaborating with sales, product, and supply chain teams to ensure alignment on pricing, inventory, and brand positioning.

I. Roles and Responsibilities

  • A. Strategic Planning
  • Develop and implement eCommerce marketing strategies for Mercado Libre and other market places in Argentina, Chile, Peru, Colombia, Ecuador, and other assigned accounts.
  • Identify marketing activities that support growth initiatives on marketplace platforms
  • B. Account Management
  • Act as the primary point of contact for marketing activities for assigned accounts.
  • Manage relationships with key stakeholders to ensure alignment on goals and promotions.
  • C. Performance Analysis
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, traffic metrics, and KPIs for all accounts.
  • Ability to prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly reports and insights for stakeholders.
  • Understand customer search trends & Cricut’s brand positioning within each platform
  • D. Campaign Management
  • Plan and execute marketing campaigns tailored to each platform/marketplace.
  • Manage promotional calendar, including product launches and seasonal promotions.
  • Maintain pacing levels within monthly, quarterly, & annual budgets
  • E. Content Development
  • Oversee the creation and optimization of product listings to improve visibility and conversion rates.
  • Work closely with product marketing to ensure high-quality content
  • Manage brand stores within accounts, ensuring optimal customer shopping experience
  • F. Pricing and Inventory Management
  • Provide discovered insights around pricing & inventory to sales lead. Sales lead will own overall pricing & inventory, but marketing can provide insights from marketing-related findings.
  • Support sales with supply chain and pricing teams to set competitive pricing strategies.
  • Support sales with monitoring inventory levels to prevent stockouts and ensure timely replenishment. Monitor lost buy box % on Amazon.

Comprehensive report outlining quarterly marketing strategies and budget allocations for respective countries and assigned accounts.

Campaign Performance Analysis

Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly performance reports detailing successes, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

Optimized Product Listings

Regular updates to product listings based on SEO best practices and market trends.

Promotional Calendar

A weekly calendar of promotions and key marketing initiatives for the year.

III. Tasks

A. Daily Tasks

  • Monitor sales and traffic data across all accounts.
  • Respond to inquiries from Amazon account representatives and the third-party reseller.
  • Walk the store of key accounts & channels to ensure positive customer experience

B. Weekly Tasks

  • Review performance metrics and adjust marketing strategies as needed.
  • Audit & optimize paid search accounts (budgets, keyword coverage, cleanup, bid adjustments)
  • Conduct competitor analysis to identify trends and opportunities

C. Monthly Tasks

  • Hold strategy and performance review meetings with stakeholders.
  • Prepare monthly Amazon review deck for key accounts
  • Plan upcoming monthly campaigns and promotional activities.

D. Quarterly Tasks

  • Perform a comprehensive review of account performance and adjust long-term strategies accordingly
  • Conduct search trend audits & ad coverage analysis. Provide sales & broader teams recommended changes in ad coverage
  • Collaborating with sales prepare customer presentations (QBR)
  • Refresh product page, brand store, & advertising content throughout the quarter when necessary (creative rotations, seasonal events, updated assets)

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, E-Commerce, or related field.
  • 5+ years of e-commerce marketing experience, preferably in LATAM marketplaces like Mercado Libre.
  • Proven experience in campaign management, search and display advertising, content optimization, and marketplace strategy.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to track KPIs and deliver actionable insights.
  • Experience managing product listings, brand stores, and promotional calendars.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; fluent in English and Spanish for LATAM market communication.

Additional Information

Brazil, Mexico, or Argentina-based candidate preferred.

Cricut is in a powerful chapter of transformation. We’re evolving fast—refining our strategy, growing our teams, and raising the bar across the board. This is an incredible opportunity for the right kind of person—but it’s not for everyone.

We’re looking for A-players—people who don’t just meet expectations, but consistently exceed them. If you thrive in dynamic environments and find joy in turning challenges into momentum, keep reading.

Here’s what makes someone a great fit for this role (and for this moment at Cricut):

You have a bias for urgency.

You don’t wait for perfect clarity to take action—you start, learn, and adjust. You believe that speed matters, especially when paired with thoughtfulness. You ask: “What can move forward today?” and push past inertia.

You set high standards—especially for yourself.

You’re proud of your work and protective of your reputation. You take ownership, deliver quality, and don’t cut corners. You hold yourself accountable without waiting to be asked.

You stay focused when things are moving fast.

You can identify what really matters and don’t get distracted by noise. You prioritize well and manage your time wisely.

You elevate the people around you, communicate clearly, and give thoughtful feedback. You’re low ego, high output—and your team loves working with you.

What to Do Next:

Please attach your resume, cover letter and/or include links to your portfolio or other social presence. If you want to show your super powers in other ways – include that information too. You can be sure that Cricut is an employer who values individuality, equality and diversity, so tell us what you’re all about. If you are a Maker or a DIY enthusiast, whether you think you are a good one or not, we would love to hear about it when you send us your information.

Cricut is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. This position is contingent on successfully completing a Criminal Background Check upon hire. Cricut participates in E-Verify.

title: IT Data and Reporting Analyst
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

We are hiring an IT Data and Reporting Analyst to join a multinational company recognized as a leader in the industrial sealing solutions sector. The professional will have daily interaction in English with international teams and will be responsible for supporting the implementation of a reporting tool integrated with the JD Edwards (JDE) ERP system, as well as providing ongoing support to business users. It is essential to have knowledge of JDE and proficiency in SQL, with an analytical profile and the ability to transform data into insights to support strategic decision-making.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related technology fields;
  • Advanced/Fluent English (reading, writing, and communication);
  • Experience in report development with Hubble / ReportsNow / Power BI;
  • Functional knowledge of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne (JDE E1);
  • Proficiency in SQL (data analysis, troubleshooting, queries, etc.);
  • Experience as an IT Business Analyst;
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Visio, Excel, PowerPoint).

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work closely with the project team to implement a reporting tool connected to the ERP system, ensuring data accuracy and business continuity;
  • Validate, rebuild, and optimize reports during and after the migration process;
  • Design and develop new reports, dashboards, KPIs, and visualizations to meet evolving business needs;
  • Provide ongoing support to business users, assisting with report creation, interpretation, and troubleshooting;
  • Act as a subject matter expert for data and reporting within the Run and Maintain team;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand reporting needs and deliver effective solutions;
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and automate routine tasks;
  • Maintain data quality, security, and compliance with company standards;
  • Document processes, report specifications, and user guides as required;
  • Create documentation to assist business users with recurring issues (KBA Knowledge Base Articles);
  • Perform administrative and other assigned tasks;
  • Train end-users on system functionalities;
  • Support stakeholders in understanding their requirements and addressing their needs.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS

  • Availability for international travel;
  • Experience with JIRA.

BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

  • Annual bonus: 10% of the annual salary;
  • Bradesco health plan: no fixed monthly cost, only co-pay for consultations and basic exams.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Contract: CLT (Brazilian labor law);
  • Location: Remote (Home Office) with reporting in English.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Contrato: CLT

Localização: Remota

title: Onboarding Specialist, Migration
description:
Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

At Boulevard, our Customer Experience team is dedicated to launching, supporting, and strengthening relationships with our clients. As an Onboarding Specialist , Data Migrations , you will play a pivotal role in helping customers transition from legacy systems to the Boulevard platform with minimal disruption and maximum confidence.

You'll be the technical partner behind the scenes—transforming, cleaning, and validating data to ensure accuracy, security, and a seamless migration experience. From pre-sale planning through post-launch cleanup, you'll own end-to-end data migration workflows while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure every customer launch is a success.

What you'll do here:

Pre-Sale & Scoping

  • Meet with prospective clients pre-close to understand their data needs and align migration expectations.
  • Partner with Sales to scope technical requirements and validate feasibility.
  • Participate in customer and prospect calls as a subject matter expert on data migrations.

Data Migration & Import

  • Own and manage full-service and free import migrations from initial planning through final execution.
  • Perform imports using tools such as Flatfile and Google Sheets with high accuracy and consistency.
  • Execute structured QA and validation checks on all data prior to launch.
  • Handle migration-related CFDs/CSRs and execute bulk updates (e.g., pricing changes, contact edits).
  • Clean up migrations on launch day in partnership with Onboarding Specialists, focusing on data integrity.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Coordinate full-service migrations with teams like Odetta and Customer Operations (COPS).
  • Work closely with Engineering to manage escalations, track bugs, and improve tooling.
  • Partner with COPS and Engineering on Flatfile improvements and onboarding tools.
  • Support Onboarding Specialists in resolving real-time data issues during customer launches.

Operational & Team Support

  • Track migration timelines, coordinate launch calendars, and communicate progress and blockers clearly.
  • Answer internal team questions in shared Slack channels (#onboarding-questions, etc.).
  • Assist in data review for proof-of-concept migrations for strategic accounts.
  • Create and maintain internal documentation and one-sheets related to migrations and tooling.

What you'll need to thrive:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing data migrations or working with platform dashboards.
  • 1+ year of direct experience with Boulevard dashboard and data migrations (preferred).
  • Advanced skills in Google Sheets or Excel -comfortable with formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and structured data manipulation.
  • Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving abilities under pressure.
  • Excellent project and time management—able to juggle multiple migrations simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong commitment to data accuracy and security.
  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to collaborate across departments and work independently.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with Flatfile or similar structured import tools.
  • Experience with SaaS onboarding, technical support, or customer implementation.
  • Knowledge of data privacy best practices, especially around marketing consent and HIPAA customer data handling.

How we'll take care of you:

Your starting budgeted cash compensation for this role is between $64,000 - $92,000, depending on your current skills, experience, training, and overall market demands. This total compensation range is subject to change, and there is always room for growth and advancement.

In addition to the wonderful people you'll get to work with and challenging projects that'll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you're always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically.

  • We've got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance.
  • Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy.
  • Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You'll receive a work from home stipend every month.
  • Family planning resources and specialized support programs.
  • Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard.
  • Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve.

title: Manager of Instructional Teams
description:
About Us

Fullstack Academy is America's preeminent tech-training bootcamp. From coding to Ai, and cyber security to data analytics, we offer comprehensive and immersive online programs that have helped thousands of professionals launch their careers in the most vibrant sectors of today's economy.

"Fullstack Academy has been a life-changing experience" is something we hear often and the reason why we come to work everyday. We’re looking for a part-time Instructor to help transform the lives of our students, and through them, their communities and economies.

Role

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Manager of Instructional Teams, reporting to the Director of Student Experience and Success, is responsible for overseeing the learner experience while supporting the instructional staff in delivering high-quality instruction. The role supports student progress and drives retention by monitoring cohort health metrics, managing transfers and dismissals, and ensuring compliance with company policies and regulations. The Manager of Instructional Teams provides ongoing coaching and evaluation for instructors, supervises Learner Experience Managers and the Manager of Curriculum, and partners with HR and recruiting on faculty hiring, onboarding, and staffing. By managing instructional resources, maintaining SOPs, and supporting curriculum updates, the Manager of Instructional Teams ensures academic operations run efficiently and consistently. This leadership role plays a critical part in strengthening teaching effectiveness, supporting instructional staff, and enhancing the overall student experience.

This role is full-time and remote. Please note: the ability to flex hours is critical in supporting instructional team members and will be an expectation of the person in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure an exceptional student experience by supporting student progress, accessibility, and overall success
  • Oversee student experience by monitoring progress and retention, implementing strategies for improvement
  • Manage student transfers, withdrawals, and dismissals in accordance with company policies
  • Serve as a point of escalation for student concerns and resolutions
  • Develop student accommodation plans, ensuring alignment of practices with ADA requirements
  • Monitor cohort health metrics, analyzing both qualitative and quantitative feedback to measure overall student experience
  • Design and implement strategies to improve NPS, retention, and instructional quality
  • Lead and support instructional staff to strengthen teaching effectiveness, ensure compliance, and maintain high instructional quality
  • Evaluate instructors on a regular cadence, providing coaching and feedback for continuous improvement
  • Collaborate with recruiting and human resources on hiring, onboarding, and management of instructional team members
  • Oversee cohort staffing and coverage, ensuring compliance with regulations, including adequate substitute support
  • Supervise a team of Learner Experience Managers, supporting their day-to-day operations
  • Oversee program alignment, instructional delivery, and operational effectiveness to ensure consistency and quality across all cohorts
  • Liaise between Finance and Learner Experience teams to improve retention outcomes
  • Collaborate with the curriculum team to update courses with new iterations based on learner and staff feedback
  • Supervise the Manager of Curriculum, aligning tasks with student needs
  • Collaborate with Enrollment and Career Success teams to ensure seamless student transitions
  • Manage instructional costs by monitoring resource and staffing allocations
  • Update and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for instructional teams and develop additional SOPs when needed

Qualifications

You're a great candidate if you have:

  • 1 year of experience in a technical field- web development, data analytics, cybersecurity, or teaching technology
  • Proficient in using learning management systems, electronic resources, and emerging academic technologies
  • 2+ years of experience in education, teaching, instructional coaching, academic operations, or learning and development, specifically supporting instructors or trainers to drive learner success, managing projects, and hiring new team members
  • Bachelor's degree required. Master's Degree preferred
  • Experience with onboarding and building effective teams
  • Thrive in an ever-changing environment and can effectively lead a team through changes
  • Experience working remotely and teaching or training in an online environment
  • Strong sense of ownership and a "whatever-it-takes" attitude
  • A strong growth mindset
  • Project management and organizational skills
  • Communication skills (verbal and written), presentation skills, and computer skills
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of information

Compensation

The expected compensation for this role is $80,000 to $85,000 OTE plus benefits. Final offer amounts will be determined based on a candidate’s individual experience, skills, and qualifications.

The Role

We’re looking for a data-driven and strategic Paid Search Manager to own and optimize our campaigns across the Google Ads portfolio. Reporting to the Performance Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth and maximizing subscription volume at an efficient CAC. This role sits at the core of our growth engine, requiring a deep understanding of campaign management, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to drive subscriptions and improve conversion rates across the funnel. You will be responsible for strategy, execution, and reporting, making data-driven decisions to scale our paid search efforts effectively.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize campaigns across the full Google Ads portfolio, including Search, PMax, YouTube, Video Action, and others.
  • Lead keyword strategy and bidding across both branded and non-branded queries to maximize subscription volume at an efficient CAC.
  • Run a disciplined test-and-learn program across bidding, targeting, and funnel variations, and partner with internal data teams to evolve dashboards that surface actionable insights.
  • Drive Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) initiatives within your channels by working cross-functionally with engineering and design to develop, implement, and maintain a testing roadmap.
  • Monitor campaign performance, generate actionable insights from data, and communicate data-driven decisions to key stakeholders.
  • Stay current on Google Ads and performance marketing trends, platform changes, privacy regulations, attribution strategies, and AI-powered search features to maximize performance.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: You have 3+ years of hands-on experience managing SEM and running PPC campaigns in Google Ads, ideally in a fast-paced environment like a subscription business or an agency.
  • Data-driven mindset: You have fluency in campaign data analysis and optimization, with proficiency in Google Sheets, cohort analysis, and ROAS modeling. You have a proven ability to translate numbers into actions.
  • Platform Expertise: You have a strong understanding of search and Google-owned ad placements, including Search, PMax, YouTube, App Campaigns, and Demand Gen.
  • Cross-functional collaborator: You have the ability to work effectively with product, web, creative, and analytics teams to optimize acquisition performance from end to end.
  • Excellent communicator: You can translate complex insights into clear decisions and communicate effectively to stakeholders within and outside of the marketing team.
  • Strategic owner: You are comfortable owning strategy, execution, and reporting, and are curious, commercially aware, and comfortable making quick decisions.
  • Mission alignment: You’re excited by Skillshare’s vision of building the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with other performance marketing channels such as Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit and others.
  • Experience with international markets outside of the US or managing global accounts.
  • Experience within startup or scale-up environments.
  • Experience working with ed-tech or subscription based companies.

At Skillshare, we believe creativity thrives in an inclusive environment. We’re excited to meet candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. If you’re passionate about what we do but don’t check every single box, we’d still love to hear from you — curiosity and growth matter most to us.

Tenchi was created to tackle a real challenge: companies often face security risks because their third-parties don’t maintain the same level of cyber protection. This gap leaves even the largest organizations potentially vulnerable to incidents they can’t directly control. That’s exactly where we step in.

Our TPCRM SaaS solution, Zanshin, is the only global TPCRM solution that offers both inside-out and outside-in visibility – combining external attack surface monitoring with automated, continuous, and non-intrusive assessments of cloud infrastructure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and security controls.

Our People and Culture

At Tenchi, we build innovative technology to help companies secure their ecosystems with transparency and peace of mind. We are ambitious and purpose-driven. Our culture is rooted in intentionality, transparency, and action. We move fast, communicate openly, and invest in people who want to make an impact.

As a 100% remote company with team members across Brazil, the US, Canada, Argentina, and Spain, we embrace flexibility while solving meaningful challenges together.

Want to know more about our DNA? Watch the video.

What you’ll do?

  • Provide technical support to internal users, identifying and resolving complex IT and security-related issues.
  • Manage and configure IT assets and ensure secure and compliant environments.
  • Oversee identity and access management, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, and enforcement of least privilege principles.
  • Administer and configure endpoint protection tools, antivirus, patch management systems, and Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions.

  • Ensure best practices are followed in day-to-day operations regarding systems, access, and incident response.

  • Educate employees on security policies, awareness, and safe practices.
  • Administer AWS environments and apply best security practices, including provisioning access and permissions, implement security features, monitoring and investigating suspicious activities.
  • Collaborate with the engineering team to improve the security of CI/CD pipelines, assist in remediating vulnerabilities, and perform security reviews of changes involving Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Assist clients in implementing and maintaining SSO integrations.
  • Collaborate on strategic planning for the department in alignment with business needs, utilizing OKRs, roadmaps, business plans, and budget planning.

What we’re looking for?

  • Proven experience with Windows and Unix-like operating systems.
  • Strong background in providing technical support to end users.
  • Experience with access management processes, including provisioning and revoking access securely.
  • Strong background with Google Workspace and Slack administration from a security perspective.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing antivirus software, patch management systems, and MDM tools.

About Ethos

Ethos was built to make it faster and easier to get life insurance for the next million families. Our approach blends industry expertise, technology, and the human touch to find you the right policy to protect your loved ones.

We leverage deep technology and data science to streamline the life insurance process, making it more accessible and convenient. We’ve issued billions in coverage each month and eliminated the traditional barriers, ushering the industry into the modern age. Our full-stack technology platform is the backbone of family financial health.

We make getting life insurance easier, faster and better for everyone.

Our investors include General Catalyst, Sequoia Capital, Accel Partners, Google Ventures, SoftBank, and the investment vehicles of Jay-Z, Kevin Durant, Robert Downey Jr and others. This year, we were named on CB Insights' Global Insurtech 50 list and BuiltIn's Top 100 Midsize Companies in San Francisco. We are scaling quickly and looking for passionate people to protect the next million families!

Ethos is seeking a dynamic expert to take ownership of our regulatory product and forms filing. In this role, you’ll blend hands-on regulatory acumen with forward-looking product innovation to bring life insurance solutions to the market efficiently and compliantly. You’ll collaborate with carriers and cross-functional teams to navigate complex state regulations, ensuring new products and policy forms are designed, filed, and approved seamlessly. Your industry relationships and deep subject-matter expertise will be essential to influence regulators, shape product designs, and accelerate approvals.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead Filing: Own and manage the Ethos portion of the filing process for policy forms and applications, ensuring speed, compliance, and quality.
  • Inform Product Development Strategy: Collaborate with Product, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, and carrier partners to refine product features and applications that balance innovation with regulatory standards.
  • Optimize Application Design: Provide expert guidance on bracketing, reflexive questions, and variability, enabling flexible yet compliant product offerings.
  • Monitor Industry Trends: Stay ahead of regulatory changes and competitor filings, translating insights into tangible strategies and recommendations for product evolution.
  • Improve Processes Continuously: Innovate on filing processes by implementing best practices and technology solutions, bolstering efficiency and accuracy.

Qualifications and Skills

  • 5+ years in product form filings with strong understanding of state insurance department standards and requirements.
  • Broad knowledge of insurance products and regulatory frameworks.
  • Ability to read and interpret laws and regulations related to product and endorsement forms and filings.
  • Proven ability to shape and refine insurance applications, other new business and disclosure forms, and related statements of variability based on internal, Carrier, and Regulator feedback.
  • Strong collaborative communication skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with carriers, legal, and compliance, UW, product development and product teams.
  • Highly self-sufficient and entrepreneurial, capable of driving both strategic initiatives, day-to-day filings, and forms creation and maintenance.
  • Experience in SERFF system a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; JD, CPCU, FLMI, or AIRC a plus.
  • Ownership: Take the reins of product regulatory filings and guide the creation of innovative solutions.
  • Industry Influence: Build on your regulator relationships and shape the market through strategic advocacy.
  • Impactful Collaboration: Partner with a wide range of teams to harmonize regulatory needs with product vision.
  • High-Growth Environment: Join a rapidly evolving organization where your expertise can drive both immediate and long-term success.

If you’re ready to lead the charge in filing next-generation life insurance products—from concept to approval—we’d love to connect!

title: Freight Coordinator
description:
Commitment: Full-time (Approx. 40 hours/week)

Company Overview:

Tidal is a Direct Placement Agency that helps job seekers find job opportunities for real growth. We work with stable, responsible businesses experienced in remote hires and are excited to welcome international team members. Tidal is owned and operated by consumer brand owners and operators. We have offshore team-building experience and aim to help businesses leverage global talent.

About This Role:

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Freight Coordinator to join the Logistics team of one of our valued clients. The right candidate will thrive in a remote setting and be responsible for managing the end-to-end freight scheduling and delivery process. This includes coordinating pickups and deliveries, handling exception management, overseeing return shipments, and ensuring data accuracy. The ideal candidate will be proactive, possess strong communication skills, and have a deep understanding of logistics and freight operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Communicate with carriers, freight forwarders, 3PL warehouses, and retail partners to coordinate pickup and delivery schedules.
  • Schedule and confirm inventory pick-ups from 3PL warehouses based on shipping plans.
  • Coordinate delivery appointments with retail partners and carriers to ensure timely arrivals.
  • Manage shipping documentation, including BOLs, labels, packing slips, and invoices.
  • Track shipments in transit and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
  • Monitor delivery status and resolve issues like delays, missed pick-ups, and damage claims.
  • Handle reverse logistics and manage return shipments from stores to 3PL warehouses.
  • Ensure accurate documentation and tracking of returned inventory.
  • Maintain shipment logs, track KPIs, and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Act as the main point of contact for freight scheduling and updates with internal and external teams.

Software/Platforms/Tools:

  • ERP Software (e.g., Netsuite)
  • TMS (Transportation Management Systems)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)
  • Shipment tracking tools
  • Excel
  • Google Sheets
  • Google Suite
  • Slack
  • Zoom
  • Monday.com

Qualifications:

  • At least 3-5 years of freelancing experience
  • 2+ years of experience in freight coordination, logistics, or supply chain support, ideally with retail and/or 3PL exposure.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple shipments and exceptions simultaneously.
  • Experience working with ERP (e.g., Netsuite), TMS (Transportation Management Systems), WMS (Warehouse Management Systems), or shipment tracking tools.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency with Excel and Google Sheets for shipment tracking and reporting.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/offshore environment and manage time zones effectively.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience working with U.S.-based logistics operations.
  • Familiarity with retail distribution and reverse logistics processes.

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Docusign reserves the right to change a position\'s job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

  • Experience documenting and tracking customer interactions and outcomes in CRM or engagement platforms
  • Experience identifying patterns in customer feedback and escalating issues appropriately

Preferred

  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to craft clear, professional, and customer-friendly responses
  • Ability to triage customer needs effectively by routing to internal resources or providing relevant self-help content
  • Demonstrated ability to identify trends from customer inquiries and contribute to content development or response libraries

  • Understanding of customer lifecycle stages and how to drive adoption through digital touchpoints
  • Proven ability to collaborate across functions (e.g., Product, Marketing, Support, Sales) to align on messaging and resolve customer needs
  • Strong attention to detail with experience managing multiple tasks or workflows in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly organized and able to manage a digital task queue with accuracy, timeliness, and attention to detail
  • Comfortable collaborating across teams, including Customer Success, Product, Support, and Sales, to ensure aligned messaging and support
  • Proactive, adaptable, and able to contribute to process improvements in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Willingness to continuously build product knowledge to support effective customer guidance and triage decisions

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

The Service Delivery Manager is accountable for a particular service that is delivered by a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or a set of providers. This individual ensures effective delivery of services in order to meet or exceed business expectations for such services, while achieving appropriate balance between quality of outcomes, risk to systems and customers, and the life cycle cost of such services.

title: Senior Manager - Transaction Advisory Services (TAS)
description:
Overview


We’re looking for a Senior Manager to help lead our growing Transaction Advisory Services (TAS) team.


This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who is passionate about financial due diligence and M&A strategy, and has the desire to take the lead in helping expand a service line. If you join the team, you will lead projects that shape the future of businesses, working with a highly collaborative team that values precision, insight, integrity and superior client service. You’ll be integral to developing the framework for the team, while leveraging your experience to build on what we have.


If you are a self starter who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoy working directly with executives, and have a knack for uncovering the story behind the numbers, this could be your next big move.



Work arrangement


Our tax and audit teams may be spread across the country, but they work together seamlessly and successfully – and unlike many of our competitors, we have not had an RTO mandate. That said, we require this position to be situated locally to the Portland or Seattle market – you are working with local business leaders, after all.


Interested in moving to Portland? That works too – and we will help cover the cost. Please be explicit about this in your resume or cover letter if you choose to do one.



Culture and flexibility


A culture where flexibility and balance add up to success.


We know that advisory work can be intense, which is why we’ve built a culture that respects your time, values your expertise, and supports your growth. Our expectations are clear and reasonable, and we work together to meet deadlines without burning out.


While this role does not have chargeable hours expectations, you will need to be adept and flexible to react to deal flow, which means riding the peaks and valleys that come with the work. Rest assured, you won’t be a lone wolf – and you’ll be surrounded by smart, driven professionals who believe in working hard and celebrating wins—together.



Recharge and benefits


Recharge and refocus.


We believe in balance. That’s why we offer generous time off, including 5 weeks of PTO , 14.5 paid holidays , and paid leave options, including parental leave. We want you to bring your best self to work—and that starts with taking care of yourself.



Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration (required)

  • CPA (preferred)

  • 7+ years of public accounting experience, including 3+ years in financial audit or TAS (preferred)

  • Previous Due Diligence experience (preferred)

  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and technical accounting areas

  • Proven ability to lead due diligence engagements, including quality of earnings, working capital, and financial analysis

  • Experience interacting with C-level executives and managing client relationships

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to successfully adapt and convey messages to all levels of management

  • Demonstrated project management experience, and strong analytical skills to identify and support issues and resolutions to deal structures

  • Ability to travel as needed



What you’ll do



  • Lead and manage financial due diligence engagements for buy- and sell-side transactions, including serving as primary contact for duration of due diligence process

  • Analyze quality of earnings, working capital, forecasts, and key financial metrics of target client

  • Identify risks and issues impacting deal structure and purchase agreements

  • Identifies and proposes appropriate resolutions on a timely basis for critical issues related to the M&A process

  • Oversee preparation of financial due diligence reports and present findings to clients

  • Manages the development of proposal documents, and conducts presentations in pursuit of acquiring new clients

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships and identify business development opportunities

  • Collaborates cross departmentally to identify and promote the services of the TAS practice to existing and prospective clients, in addition to identifying cross-selling opportunities to other services lines

  • Mentor and develop TAS team members



Compensation and benefits



  • Salary range is $165K - $185K annually, varying DOE. Compensation may be adjusted for those who live in areas with a higher cost of labor than Portland, OR

  • 401(k) profit sharing plan; immediate vesting of employer contributions

  • 14.5 paid holidays, 5 weeks of paid time-off (PTO), parental leave

  • Incentive plan for sales leads



A company you’ll feel proud to be part of


We don’t like to brag, but we have some significant accolades under our belt—all thanks to our passionate teams. At Perkins, we feel good about our work and love that our community feels good about it, too.



  • #1 Most Admired Accounting firm in Oregon & SW Washington. 16 years on Oregon's Most Admired Companies list (Portland Business Journal)

  • A Most Diverse Accounting Firm in Portland Metro (Portland Business Journal)

  • Best of Accounting Diamond Award Winner for Exceptional Client Service (ClearlyRated)

  • Largest women-owned accounting firm in Oregon & Clark and Skamania counties, WA.

  • America's Best Tax and Accounting Firms (Forbes)

  • Best Accountant of Portland (Willamette Week reader's poll)



Ready to make your move? Just send us your resume or LinkedIn profile—no cover letter required.

Join us on our mission to empower fearless commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here!

Department

The Legal team at Signifyd plays a critical role in enabling and protecting the business as it scales. Our team is responsible for drafting and negotiating contracts, reviewing privacy and data protection matters, supporting product development, and overseeing corporate governance. We work closely with the Sales, Partnerships, Product, Revenue Operations (RevOps), and Finance teams to help drive business objectives forward. By shaping processes that accelerate deal cycles, we help keep the commercial flywheel turning. At the same time, we ensure Signifyd’s risk exposure is carefully managed and our sensitive data is safeguarded through robust contractual protections.

Role

As a Legal Operations and Contracts Manager , you’ll help shape and optimize our legal systems and contracting processes while also drafting, reviewing, and negotiating agreements. You’ll collaborate with teams across the company to streamline deal cycles, improve our Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) tools, and support critical agreements such as NDAs, MSAs, and order forms.

We’re a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately. This is a hands-on role with significant opportunities for growth, perfect for someone who can balance business objectives with legal considerations, enjoys cross-functional collaboration, and thrives in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

  • Contract Negotiation: Review, draft and negotiate a variety of contracts, including nondisclosure agreements, master service agreements and statements of work.
  • Contract Lifecycle Management: Manage the entire contract lifecycle from intake and drafting to negotiation, execution, and renewal, including maintaining and managing our contract repository and electronic databases.
  • Sales and Stakeholder Advisory: Act as a primary point of contact for the sales team and other internal stakeholders, providing guidance and coordination throughout the contract lifecycle to ensure efficient and compliant deal execution.
  • Process Optimization: Develop, maintain, and enforce policies and standard operating procedures for legal and contracting processes. Continuously identify opportunities to accelerate contract closure by enhancing templates, streamlining negotiation workflows, and clarifying escalation guidelines.
  • System Administration: Act as the primary legal team interface with other departments in structuring cross-departmental functions, including the establishment and enhancement of company-wide IT systems, particularly our CLM tool.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Manage standard and ad-hoc reporting and metrics related to contract volume, turnaround times, and other key performance indicators to inform strategic decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the team to continually identify opportunities to accelerate contract closure, respond to inquiries effectively, and develop comprehensive contracting policies.
  • Innovation Champion: Be a champion for a better, faster, and simpler way of doing things within the legal and contracting functions.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in a legal operations or contract management role.
  • 4+ years proven experience drafting and reviewing commercial contracts, including MSAs, Order Forms, and NDAs.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the full contract lifecycle process and administration in a time-sensitive environment.

    • Network penetration testing and manipulation of network infrastructure

Overview

Would you like to make an impact by leading one of our fashion store teams that are community based, offer amazing choice and genuine sustainability?

What does this role involve?

As a Store Manager you will be accountable for your store's performance, maximising sales through physical and digital channels, and achieving store targets by leading an inclusive and diverse team that consistently demonstrate the BHF values. Each day is different in this varied, fast paced and hands on role. Due to the volume of donations, it can be physically demanding at times, yet most rewarding as you play a part in helping to fund life saving research. You will join us on a 6-month fixed term contract.

Responsibilities

  • Operate in a fast paced, hands-on environment; manage the daily activities of the store.

  • Commit to working weekends and bank holidays on a rota basis as stores trade 7 days a week.
  • Understand budgets and P&L to support commercial decisions.

What are we looking for?

  • Experience working in a customer facing role in retail, hospitality or service industry.
  • Experience of leading, motivating and developing teams.
  • Commercial awareness; ability to achieve sales targets.

What’s important to us?

At the British Heart Foundation (BHF) we offer a huge range of new and used quality furniture, clothing, jewellery and more, available in store and online.

Our vision is a world where everyone has a healthier heart for longer. We fund cutting-edge research and innovation to save and improve more lives. In addition to raising funds, we connect with local communities and help reduce clothing and furniture waste across the UK. With over 700 stores we make a significant environmental impact by preventing around 70,000 tonnes of unwanted items from going to landfill each year. We receive 1.6 million items donated to our home stores and 9.8 million bags of donated items, and we will continue to build on our reuse agenda in the years to come.

Our Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) Strategy, Igniting Change, along with our internal EDI group, Kaleidoscope, and a growing number of employee network groups (Affinity Groups), help us create an environment where all colleagues and volunteers can succeed.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Integrations)
description:
About the Role

  • Own end-to-end delivery of integration projects — from technical discovery and design through deployment — partnering closely with Product, Implementation, and clients to ensure alignment and impact.

  • Evaluate scope and requirements critically: surface ambiguities early, challenge assumptions, and reframe trade-offs to ensure clarity before execution.

  • Communicate progress, risks, and blockers proactively through tickets, stand-ups, and async updates, ensuring clarity and predictability for teammates and stakeholders.

  • Contribute thoughtful, detailed peer reviews that raise the bar for code quality, maintainability, and extensibility.

  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying technical debt, proposing design or tooling enhancements, and sharing best practices that improve team velocity and reliability.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with empathy and clarity, ensuring requirements are well-scoped and trade-offs are clearly communicated.

About the Team

  • A fast-moving Integration squad connecting banking COREs to Clutch’s platform.

  • Success hinges less on raw code complexity and more on understanding product context, making sound trade-offs, and coordinating with multiple parties.

  • We collaborate closely with Product, clients, and other engineering teams to deliver production-ready integrations quickly.

  • Transparency and balanced workload are core values: everyone is expected to surface blockers early and help redistribute work when needed.

  • We champion autonomy—engineers are trusted to take initiative, switch contexts effectively, and push changes all the way to production.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Debug and resolve issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Take ownership of smaller features end-to-end, from clarifying requirements to deployment.

  • Build working knowledge of multiple core integrations and explain their impact on the product.

  • Proactively ask questions, surface risks, and challenge assumptions early to improve clarity and scope of work.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Drive predictable delivery by proactively communicating progress, risks, and blockers without being prompted.

  • Confidently operate across different integration contexts, making informed tradeoffs and documenting decisions.

  • Lead technical implementation for a feature or partner go-live, coordinating with stakeholders for alignment.

  • Anticipate potential problems in requirements or design, reframing them with data and alternative solutions before they become blockers.

  • Contribute high-quality code reviews that not only ensure standards, but also provide mentorship and elevate peers’ design and coding practices.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Lead and deliver a small-to-medium scoped project independently, including technical design, planning, and rollout.

  • Build trust with cross-functional and external stakeholders by representing engineering context and constraints clearly.

  • Proactively identify technical debt or process gaps and drive initiatives to resolve them with measurable impact.

  • Demonstrate readiness for the next level by consistently owning delivery, influencing peers, and shaping team practices that raise the overall bar.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong product-oriented mindset, able to connect technical decisions with business impact.

  • Proven ability to debug and resolve complex issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Implementation, and external stakeholders to align on scope and trade-offs.

  • Consistent ownership of small-to-medium projects end-to-end, from discovery and design to deployment and follow-up.

  • Ability to critically evaluate requirements, anticipate risks, and propose pragmatic alternatives that improve clarity and delivery outcomes.

  • Proficient in advanced English communication, both written and spoken.

  • Plus: previous experience with integrations or core banking systems is a strong differentiator.

Please note that this role may evolve as our business needs change, so we appreciate your flexibility and adaptability.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.

  • Unforgettable Off-Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.

  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.

  • Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.

  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.

  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note: This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI at Clutch

We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation.

That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

The Senior Partner Solutions Architect is a strategic technical leader responsible for driving the successful integration of partners onto the Remote platform. This role acts as the primary technical bridge between our products and our partners' needs, owning the technical relationship from pre-sales qualification through to post-sales implementation and scaling. The ideal candidate will combine deep API and integration expertise with strong consultative skills to design and deliver high-value solutions that accelerate partner-driven revenue and expand Remote’s ecosystem.

What you bring

  • Deep expertise in API design, enterprise integrations, and technical solution architecture within a partner-facing or sales engineering context.
  • Proven ability in rapid prototyping, technical troubleshooting, and leading complex integration projects from discovery to launch.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience creating high-quality technical documentation, training materials, and enablement resources.
  • Proficiency with modern sales and development tools, including Salesforce and generative AI platforms for accelerating content creation, code review, and analysis.
  • Writes and speaks fluent English
  • It's not required to have experience working remotely, but considered a plus

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner-Facing Technical Leadership
    • Lead the technical sales cycle for strategic partnerships, conducting discovery sessions, delivering tailored API-focused product demonstrations, and designing robust integration solutions.
    • Scope, plan, and lead the delivery of technical proof-of-concept (POC) projects, serving as the technical lead on partner calls and projects.
    • Act as the primary technical advisor for partners, helping triage critical integration issues and providing expert guidance in scoping, planning, and implementation to ensure successful adoption and long-term success.
  • Technical Enablement & Scaling
    • Develop and maintain a comprehensive library of technical enablement materials, including implementation guides, best practice documents, and technical readmes for both partners and internal teams.
    • Create and improve scalable resources, such as the open-source "Remote API Demo" application, to enhance partner engagement and streamline the sales process.
    • Serve as a subject matter expert on Remote’s API and integration capabilities, providing internal training and acting as an onboarding buddy to scale the collective expertise of the Solutions Architect team.
  • Strategic Collaboration & Product Influence
    • Act as a key technical liaison between partners, sales, product, and engineering teams to ensure tight alignment on Remote Embedded product roadmaps and technical deliverables.
    • Translate partner and customer requirements into detailed product requirements and business requirements, identifying product gaps and advocating for enhancements based on market feedback.
    • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Solutions Architect function by refining processes, introducing new tools, and providing strategic input on team growth.
  • Measures of Success
    • Increased win rates and revenue growth from partner-driven opportunities.
    • High partner and customer satisfaction scores based on the quality and effectiveness of technical solutions.
    • Successful delivery and adoption of partner integrations.
    • Tangible contributions to the team's knowledge base and the scaling of the Solutions Architect function.

title: Staff Software Engineer- Scalability & Interactions

description:
Overview

We Are Hiring

  • Department: Infrastructure
  • Schedule: Full-time, 8 hour day shift, Monday - Friday
  • Location: Remote
  • Salary: $118,129.00 - $159,821.00 per year

What You Will Do

Role Purpose

The Cloud Service Delivery Manager is accountable for the public cloud infrastructure environment supported by Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and/or Cloud Operations teams. This individual ensures that services are delivered effectively to meet or exceed business expectations while balancing quality, risk, and cost. The role requires strong vendor management, IT service delivery expertise, and leadership in cross-functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Service Delivery
    • Monitor and ensure delivery of services within agreed service levels and contractual obligations.
    • Oversee daily, weekly, and monthly service reviews; approve and validate review materials for accuracy.
    • Proactively track and measure service performance and metrics, ensuring issues are documented, resolved, and communicated effectively.
    • Validate adherence to corporate architectural guidelines, standards, and risk/security policies.
    • Approve service improvement plans, capacity planning reports, and root cause analyses for systemic issues.
    • Identify opportunities to optimize MSP portfolios and leverage existing services for improved business outcomes.
    • Act as the escalation point for significant incidents affecting infrastructure and service availability.
    • Represent Service Delivery in governance meetings, including Infrastructure PMO Oversight.
  • Incident & Major Incident Management
    • Serve as an escalation point for significant incidents and coordinate resolution efforts.
    • Join and actively manage bridges for Major Incidents (MIBs), particularly those impacting hospitals or national services.
    • Ensure incident communications follow established playbooks and that ServiceNow records are accurate and complete.
    • Participate in after-hours on-call rotation for critical incident management.
  • Service Level Management
    • Negotiate, review, and enforce SLAs with vendors and MSPs.
    • Monitor SLA performance, ensuring accountability for consistent delivery.
    • Assess service management processes and recommend modifications to improve efficiency and reliability.

Financial Management (in collaboration with FinOps)

  • Reviews vendor/MSP invoices for accuracy, partners with FinOps to resolve discrepancies, and ensures costs align with budgets and forecasts.
  • Provides service delivery insights to improve cost transparency for business partners.
  • Ensures financial data related to service delivery is accurate and aligned with strategic objectives.
  • Recommends technology or process improvements that enhance IT value and may reduce delivery costs.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with organizational risk management policies and IT security standards.
  • Manage waiver and CEP exemption reviews and approvals.
  • Oversee technology lifecycle management for infrastructure components.
  • Drive audit readiness and follow-up for customer survey investigations and compliance assessments.

Vendor & Resource Management

  • Manage MSP onboarding/offboarding in HR and vendor systems (PeopleSoft, Beeline, SailPoint).
  • Oversee account provisioning, expirations, and access management (including CyberArk and privileged account standards).
  • Build strong vendor relationships, fostering accountability, transparency, and collaboration.

Leadership & Communication

  • Communicate effectively across all levels of the organization, including executives, business stakeholders, and technical SMEs.
  • Facilitate conflict resolution and negotiations with MSPs and internal teams.
  • Demonstrate urgency, accountability, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Write clearly and tailor communications to the appropriate audience.
  • Build trust, collaboration, and alignment with organizational values and culture.

Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of IT service delivery management, including direct oversight of MSPs.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification.
  • Strong experience in vendor management, contract/SLA negotiation, and service level management.
  • Proven financial acumen in IT budgeting, forecasting, and cost transparency.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in service delivery and incident management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of leadership or management experience.
  • Healthcare provider industry experience.
  • Certification credentialed from the International Association of Information Technology Asset Managers (IAITAM).

Key Competencies

  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage complex vendor relationships and cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and able to manage competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive service improvement, cost efficiency, and value delivery.

What You Will Need

Education:

  • High School diploma equivalency with 3 years of cumulative experience OR Associate's degree/Bachelor's degree with 2 years of cumulative experience OR 7 years of applicable cumulative job specific experience required.
  • 3 years of leadership or management experience preferred.

Additional Preferences

No additional preferences.

Na Arco, nossa missão

transformar a maneira como o conhecimento é construído nas salas de aula de todo o Brasil. Visão da posição

Você será uma das principais referências técnicas no time, com atuação ofensiva em frentes críticas como pentests de aplicações web e mobile, infraestrutura, cloud, redes e APIs. Também será responsável por apoiar a estruturação de processos ofensivos, criação de automações, disseminação de conhecimento e apoio estratégico a outras áreas da empresa.

Responsabilidades

  • Executar testes de invasão (pentests) técnicos e manuais em aplicações web, mobile, APIs, redes e infraestrutura (on-premises e cloud);
  • Conduzir análises ofensivas baseadas em frameworks como OWASP, PTES, MITRE ATT&CK e Cyber Kill Chain;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos com evidências, recomendações e planos de correção para vulnerabilidades encontradas;
  • Apoiar a operação e evolução do programa de bug bounty e exercícios de Red Team internos;

  • Apoiar o fortalecimento da esteira de CI/CD segura com foco em testes contínuos de segurança;
  • Contribuir para hardening e revisões ofensivas em ambientes multi-cloud;
  • Colaborar com times de infraestrutura na análise ofensiva de redes e servidores;
  • Apoiar a construção e revisão de políticas ofensivas e processos relacionados à postura ofensiva da organização;
  • Apoiar o time de resposta a incidentes (CSIRT) em investigações relacionadas a falhas em aplicações, APIs, infraestrutura cloud ou web, atuando na reprodução técnica, análise ofensiva e suporte na mitigação de vetores explorados.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prática em testes de intrusão (pentest) em aplicações web e mobile, APIs, infraestrutura e redes;
  • Domínio técnico de ambientes Linux, Windows e MacOs, protocolos de rede e arquitetura de aplicações distribuídas;
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de cloud computing, incluindo exploração de configurações;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de pentest, como Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Metasploit, etc.;
  • Experiência com frameworks como OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Top 10, OWASP TOP 10 FOR LLM`s, PTES, MITRE ATT&CK e Cyber Kill Chain;
  • Habilidade com linguagens de script e automação como Python ou Go;
  • Conhecimento prático em esteiras CI/CD e segurança em ambientes DevOps;
  • Certificações como: OSCP, OSWE e/ou participação em bug bounty e CTFs, inglês intermediário/técnico

Competências comportamentais

  • Capacidade de traduzir temas técnicos complexos de forma simples e objetiva para públicos diversos;
  • Perfil consultivo e colaborativo, com habilidade de atuar em conjunto com áreas técnicas e de negócio;
  • Autonomia para liderar iniciativas e conduzir investigações ofensivas complexas;
  • Boa comunicação com todos os níveis – técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Capacidade de aprendizado constante e atualização com tendências em segurança ofensiva;
  • Senso de dono e foco em entregar valor real para o negócio.

title: CDI Validation Specialist
description:
Overview

Position: CDI Validation Specialist

The CDI Validation Specialist assists the CDI Manager with oversight, evaluation, and analysis of CDI functions including efficiency, accuracy, continuing education needs, and overall quality. This individual identifies individual education needs of Clinical Documentation Specialists and collaborates with CDI Manager, IP Coding Manager, and IP Coding Validation Manager to develop appropriate training materials. The primary goal is to ensure the documentation in the chart identifies all clinical findings, diagnoses and procedures and is appropriately and clinically supported. The CDI Validation Specialist will work with the CDI Manager to leverage performance, providing feedback and influence to continually improve documentation results thereby impacting key performance indicators.

Department: Clinical Documentation

Schedule: Full Time

Responsibilities

  • Monitors CDI staff accuracy, data quality and integrity.
  • Monitors CDS review process for content, timeliness and accurate diagnosis and procedure assignment in determining a working DRG.
  • Monitors concurrent queries for compliancy, accuracy, clarity, and timeliness.
  • Audits clinical documentation specialists retrospectively to assess for completeness of chart review and query compliance including missed query opportunities, accurate coding, and adherence to AHIMA/ACDIS compliant query guidelines/standards.
  • Collaborates with CDI manager to identify, coordinate, and implement CDI specialist ongoing education and feedback based on identified opportunities for improvement via auditing.
  • Assists in orientation and training of new clinical documentation specialists
  • Reviews and analyzes denial claims and denial data to provide support in denial prevention strategies via clinical validation query process and education to CDI specialists.
  • Contributes to departmental and organizational quality performance goals, including auditing mortality and readmission cohorts to identify opportunities for improvement. Coordinate and implement CDI specialist education based on identified opportunities.
  • Collaborates with CDI manager to create and update documentation tools, processes, procedures, and work flows on an ongoing and as needed basis.
  • Reviews charts concurrently with no MCC/CCs, low SOI/ROMs and LOS not supported by working DRG.
  • Identifies and educates CDI with missed query opportunities.
  • Assists CDI manager with final DRG validation when there is a discrepancy between CDS and coder.
  • Collaborates with the CDI Manager and identifies opportunities for performance improvement activities on processes.
  • Collaborates with CDI Manager, IP Coding Manager, and IP Coding Validation Manager to strategize appropriate training methodology for individual issues.
  • Provides timely appropriate feedback to CDI Manager on any performance improvement plans for CDI staff.
  • Collaborates with other CDCI department managers to identify areas for improvement and solutions for process improvement.
  • Assures documentation is compliant with federal and state regulations, coding guidelines and hospital policies.
  • Remains up-to-date in clinical and coding/documentation-related materials, including CDS best practices as defined by ACDIS as well as ICD-10-CM/PCS, AHA Coding Clinic guidelines for coding and reporting and MS-DRG/APR-DRG classification systems.
  • Monitors regulatory and reimbursement changes.
